scope: 134 frozen research sources, their declared public exports, and bounded already-public dependencies. This is not a reconstruction of all historical project material.
hash_semantics: Historical source hashes bind the original reviewed text. A changed public copy has a distinct identity in SOURCE_EXPORT_MAP.json. The current exact delivered-byte allowlist is STAGE_FILE_MANIFEST.json and the repository PUBLIC_INVENTORY.json; historical checksum files are not those allowlists.

r011_review_mapping.boundary: The historical receipt includes an excluded administrative dependency. Only the listed already-public scientific proof, review records and identity maps are used. No full historical receipt closure or equality between the original and either public review hash is claimed.

source_reference_census.method: All standalone lowercase SHA-256 strings in selected UTF-8 documentary source files (excluding numerical JSONL/TSV and program code) were enumerated. Hashes in actual source/export mapping metadata are checked separately. This is not a parser for every informal mathematical citation.

historical_manifest_exceptions.explanation: The original administrative rows are omitted completely and a relocated research path is mapped. The 36 retained scientific entries preserve original source hashes; an excluded-paper retrieval hash is metadata only. It is not a current export allowlist.
Original audit/PDF/full-text retrieval identities remain. Only the own-research audit and this checksum ledger are selected. Neither the third-party PDF nor its full extracted text is redistributed.

bounded_antecedents.boundary: A user-project method antecedent, especially the self-contained reverse-chain lemma in section 3. Its original review-pending status is retained. The historical theorem package, auxiliary source bindings and diagnostics are not newly replayed or fully imported. It is not a newly accepted theorem in this stage.

actual_missing_records: The original overwritten D’Angelo audit version and its contemporaneous complete hash were not retained.
The original Route B path search did not save complete contemporaneous per-path records. Later buggy and corrected replay artifacts are labeled later records, not recovery.
The refined-port log summary of 7,290 equation-(10) subcases is not an additional separately retained case archive. Existing recorded fields support limited derived consistency checking.
outcome_boundary: Reviews are independent LLM reviews, not external peer review, formal proof or novelty certification. The stage records provisional interfaces and restricted results. Gate0 is incomplete, a general nonlinear fixed-bit theorem is not established, and known direct-head scaling antecedents are credited.
